newsitem.title: USA: Millennium Pharma, ChemGenics execs leave.
newsitem.headline: Millennium Pharma, ChemGenics execs leave.

text.p: Millennium Pharmaceuticals Inc said that Barry Berkowitz, chief executive officer at ChemGenics, will depart the company in June, 1997.
Millennium and ChemGenics Pharmaceuticals Inc merged in February. In the interim, Berkowitz will serve as a senior advisor to Millennium.

The company also said that it appointed Janet Bush, interim CFO at ChemGenics, to interim vice president of finance following the resignation of Harry Arader who served as chief financial officer at Millennium.
